questions.text: What percentage of the project cost is provided as a credit-linked capital subsidy under the PMFME scheme for individual micro-enterprises?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 35%.

Key Points

  • Subsidy Rate: Under the PMFME scheme, individual micro-food processing units can avail of a credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of the eligible project cost.
  • Maximum Limit: The maximum ceiling for this subsidy is Rs. 10 lakh per unit.
  • Beneficiary Contribution: The beneficiary is generally required to contribute 10% of the project cost, with the remaining amount coming from a bank loan.
  • Objective: The scheme aims to provide financial, technical, and business support for the upgradation of existing micro-food processing enterprises.

Additional Information

  • One District One Product (ODOP)
    • The scheme adopts the ODOP framework to reap the benefit of scale in terms of procurement of inputs, availing common services, and marketing of products.
  • Duration
    • The scheme is implemented over a period of five years from 2020-21 to 2024-25 with an outlay of Rs. 10,000 Crore.

questions.text: What was the theme of the National-Level Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Conclave organized by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs in March 2026?

options.text: Empowering Tribals through CSR and Pledging Partnership for Tribal Upliftment
Digital Inclusion for Remote Tribal Blocks

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Empowering Tribals through CSR and Pledging Partnership for Tribal Upliftment.

In News

  • The Ministry of Tribal Affairs organized a National-Level CSR Conclave on March 24, 2026, at Sunder Nursery, New Delhi.

Key Points

  • The theme of the conclave was “Empowering Tribals through CSR and Pledging Partnership for Tribal Upliftment”.
  • Union Minister Shri Jual Oram launched a "Solar Entrepreneur" training program in collaboration with the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
  • A 9-day residential training program supported by Tata Power Skill Development Institute was introduced for tribal youth.
  • The event aimed to bridge gaps in tribal development by fostering collaborations between the government, PSUs, and private companies.

Additional Information

  • CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility)
    • Under the Companies Act, 2013, certain companies are mandated to spend 2% of their average net profit on social development activities.
  • Ministry of Tribal Affairs
    • Union Minister: Shri Jual Oram.
    • Secretary: Smt. Ranjana Chopra.

questions.text: India submitted its First National Report (NR1) regarding the implementation of which international protocol related to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD)?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Nagoya Protocol.

In News

  • The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, along with the National Biodiversity Authority, submitted India’s first report on the Nagoya Protocol to the CBD Secretariat.

Key Points

  • Focus of Report: The report details India's progress in Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) for genetic resources.
  • Global Contribution: India accounts for over 60% of the global Internationally Recognised Certificates of Compliance (IRCCs).
  • Legislative Link: The protocol is implemented in India through the Biological Diversity Act, 2002 and the newly introduced ABS Regulations, 2025.
  • Institutional Tier: The report highlights a 3-tier system: National Biodiversity Authority (National), State Biodiversity Boards (State), and over 2.76 lakh Biodiversity Management Committees (Local).

Additional Information

  • Cartagena Protocol
    • While both are under the CBD, the Cartagena Protocol specifically deals with Biosafety (regulating the movement of Living Modified Organisms), whereas the Nagoya Protocol deals with Access and Benefit Sharing.

questions.text: The Union Cabinet has approved the Modified UDAN scheme for a 10-year period (FY 2026-27 to 2035-36) with a total financial outlay of __________.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is ₹28,840 Crore.

In News

  • The Union Cabinet, chaired by PM Narendra Modi, approved the Modified UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) scheme for ten years.

Key Points

  • The total outlay for the scheme is ₹28,840 crore, spanning from FY 2026-27 to 2035-36.
  • The scheme aims to develop 100 airports from unserved airstrips with an investment of ₹12,159 crore.
  • It includes the development of 200 modern helipads at a cost of ₹15 crore each in remote/hilly regions.
  • Under Atmanirbhar Bharat, aircraft like HAL Dhruv and HAL Dornier will be procured for Pawan Hans and Alliance Air.
  • The scheme provides Viability Gap Funding (VGF) of ₹10,043 crore to support regional airline operators.

Additional Information

  • UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik)
    • Launched in 2016, it is a regional airport development program aimed at making air travel affordable and widespread.
  • Viability Gap Funding (VGF)
    • A one-time or deferred grant provided to support infrastructure projects that are economically justified but fall short of financial viability.
  • Alliance Air & Pawan Hans
    • Public sector entities focused on regional fixed-wing connectivity and helicopter services, respectively.

questions.text: Under the Electricity (Amendment) Rules 2026, which entity is responsible for the verification of inter-state captive power status starting April 1, 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is National Load Despatch Centre.

In News

  • The Government of India has notified the Electricity (Amendment) Rules 2026, specifically amending Rule 3 of the Electricity Rules 2005.

Key Points

  • Verification Authority: Starting 1st April 2026, the National Load Despatch Centre (NLDC) will handle inter-state verification, while State or UT Governments will designate agencies for intra-state cases.
  • Ownership definition: Ownership now includes Subsidiaries, Holding Companies, and other group entities to reflect modern corporate structures.
  • Verification Period: A uniform verification period for captive status has been established for the entire Financial Year.
  • Association of Persons (AoP): Captive users under an AoP can now draw power based on operational needs without losing status, provided collective requirements are met.
  • Dispute Redressal: A dedicated Grievance Redressal Committee will be constituted to address disputes arising from verification decisions.

Additional Information

  • Captive Generating Plant (CGP)
    • A power plant set up by any person to generate electricity primarily for their own use. It helps industries secure reliable power and often reduces costs.
  • Surcharge Relief
    • Pending verification, Cross-Subsidy Surcharge and Additional Surcharge will not be levied if users submit a prescribed declaration, improving ease of doing business.

questions.text: Which Aditya Birla Group-led consortium recently acquired 100% ownership of the Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) franchise in March 2026?

options.text: ABG, Times of India Group, Bolt Ventures, and Blackstone
ABG, Adani Group, and JSW Sports
ABG, Star Sports, and Qatar Investment Authority

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is ABG, Times of India Group, Bolt Ventures, and Blackstone.

In News

  • A high-profile consortium led by the Aditya Birla Group (ABG) has acquired 100% equity in Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB).

Key Points

  • Deal Value: The acquisition is valued at a record-breaking ₹16,706 crore.
  • Seller: The stake was purchased from United Spirits Limited (USL), which owned the team through its subsidiary, Royal Challengers Sports Private Limited (RCSPL).
  • Consortium Partners: Includes Aditya Birla Group (Lead), The Times of India Group, Bolt Ventures, and Blackstone.
  • Scope: The deal includes full ownership and operating rights for both the Men’s IPL team and the Women’s Premier League (WPL) team.
  • Assets: Includes all brand assets, player contracts, and existing infrastructure.

Business Context

  • United Spirits Limited (USL)
    • An Indian alcoholic beverages company, and a subsidiary of Diageo. It was the original owner of the RCB franchise since the inception of the IPL in 2008.
  • Blackstone (BXPE)
    • One of the world's leading investment firms, participating here through its perpetual private equity strategy.

questions.text: Who is the recipient of the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in the English language category for the novel titled 'Crimson Spring'?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Navtej Sarna.

In News

  • The Sahitya Akademi announced its prestigious annual awards for 2025, honoring 24 authors across various Indian languages.

Key Points

  • English Winner: Former diplomat and author Navtej Sarna won for his novel 'Crimson Spring'.
  • Hindi Winner: Mamta Kalia was awarded for her memoir 'Jeete Jee Allahabad'.
  • Award Prize: The award includes an engraved copper plaque, a shawl, and a cash prize of Rs 1,00,000.
  • Genre Diversity: The 2025 awards recognized 8 poetry books, 4 novels, 6 short story collections, and other genres including memoirs and essays.
  • Ceremony: The awards will be formally presented on 31 March 2026 in New Delhi.

Additional Information

  • Sahitya Akademi
    • India's National Academy of Letters, founded in 1954, it is the highest honor conferred on writers by the Government of India for literary merit.
  • Scope
    • The Akademi recognizes 24 languages, which include the 22 languages listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution, along with English and Rajasthani.

questions.text: The International Conference on Carbon Markets, 'Prakriti 2026', was organized by which organization?

options.text: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI)

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE).

In News

  • The International Conference on Carbon Markets, titled 'Prakriti 2026', was organized by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) in New Delhi.

Key Points

  • Portal Launch: The event marked the launch of the Indian Carbon Market Portal (www.indiancarbonmarket.gov.in) for market administration.
  • Theme: The theme was “Unlocking Carbon Finance for NDC Implementation through Global Partnerships and Digital Pathways.”
  • Scope: The conference focused on the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), which already has 9 notified methodologies and 40+ registered entities.
  • Target Entities: Emission targets have been notified for approximately 490 entities across seven energy-intensive sectors.
  • The 3 Cs: The framework emphasizes Credibility, Capital, and Collaboration to drive clean technology investment.

What is a Carbon Market?

  • Environmental Economics
    • A Carbon Market is a trading system where carbon credits are sold and bought. One carbon credit usually equals one tonne of CO2 reduced or avoided. It allows companies or countries to compensate for their greenhouse gas emissions by financing projects that reduce emissions elsewhere.

questions.text: Who won the Chinese Grand Prix 2026, becoming a record-breaking 19-year-old winner for Mercedes?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Kimi Antonelli.

In News

  • 19-year-old Kimi Antonelli secured a historic victory for Mercedes at the 2026 Chinese Grand Prix.

Key Points

  • Historic Feat: Antonelli converted his status as the youngest pole-sitter in F1 history into a race win.
  • Mercedes 1-2: The race ended with a Mercedes dominance, as George Russell finished second behind his teammate.
  • Ferrari Milestone: Lewis Hamilton secured his first-ever podium finish for Scuderia Ferrari by placing third.
  • Championship Race: Following the win, George Russell leads the championship, but his lead over Antonelli has narrowed to only 4 points.
  • Race Incident: The event saw a major upset for McLaren as both their cars failed to start the race.

Additional Information

  • Mercedes (Silver Arrows)
    • The team has returned to a dominant position in the 2026 season, marking a strong start to the new era of technical regulations.
  • Shanghai International Circuit
    • The Chinese GP is held at this circuit, known for its unique "Shang" (上) character-shaped layout and challenging "snail" turn.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the National-Level CSR Conclave held in March 2026:
1. It was organized by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs at Sunder Nursery, New Delhi.
2. Its theme was "Empowering Tribals through CSR and Pledging Partnership for Tribal Upliftment".
3. A "Solar Entrepreneur" training program was launched during the event in collaboration with the Ministry of MSME.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 1 and 2 only.

In News

  • The Ministry of Tribal Affairs hosted the National-Level CSR Conclave on March 24, 2026.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: The event took place at Sunder Nursery, New Delhi, to foster partnerships for tribal development.
  • Statement 2 is correct: The official theme was “Empowering Tribals through CSR and Pledging Partnership for Tribal Upliftment”.
  • Statement 3 is incorrect: The "Solar Entrepreneur" program was launched in collaboration with the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), not the Ministry of MSME.
  • Union Minister Shri Jual Oram emphasized that companies have a special obligation to invest in tribal communities as these areas provide the natural resources used for nation-building.

Additional Information

  • Training Partner
    • Tata Power Skill Development Institute supported a 9-day residential training program for tribal youth.

questions.text: Who has been awarded the 2026 Mark Lynton History Prize for the book "The Golden Road: How Ancient India Transformed the World"?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is William Dalrymple.

In News

  • Historian William Dalrymple won the 2026 Mark Lynton History Prize for his latest work exploring ancient India's global influence.

Key Points

  • Winning Work: The prize was awarded for the book "The Golden Road: How Ancient India Transformed the World."
  • Prize Details: The Mark Lynton History Prize is an annual USD 10,000 award given to a work of history that combines scholarly depth with high-quality writing.
  • Administration: It is part of the J. Anthony Lukas Book Prize, administered by the Nieman Foundation and Columbia University.
  • Finalist: The other finalist for the 2026 prize was Siddharth Kara for his book "The Zorg."
  • Legacy: The award is named after Mark Lynton, a WWII veteran, business executive, and author.

Additional Information

  • William Dalrymple
    • He is a world-renowned historian and author of several acclaimed books on Indian history, including The Anarchy, White Mughals, and The Last Mughal. He is also the co-founder of the Jaipur Literature Festival.

questions.text: Who has been appointed as the official Brand Ambassador for the BHIM (Bharat Interface for Money) App?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Mahendra Singh Dhoni.

In News

  • NPCI BHIM Services Limited (NBSL) has officially named Mahendra Singh Dhoni as the Brand Ambassador for the BHIM payments app.

Key Points

  • Strategic Goal: The partnership aims to build user confidence and drive financial inclusion across India.
  • Brand Identity: Dhoni’s image of consistency and trust aligns with BHIM’s tagline, "Bharat Ka Apna Payments App."
  • Anniversary: The appointment comes as the BHIM app nears its tenth anniversary (launched in December 2016).
  • NPCI Body: The initiative is led by NPCI BHIM Services Limited (NBSL), a subsidiary of the National Payments Corporation of India.

About BHIM App

  • Digital Payments
    • BHIM (Bharat Interface for Money) is a mobile payment app developed by NPCI based on the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), allowing direct bank-to-bank transfers.

questions.text: In March 2026, the Indian Naval Sail Training Ship INS Sudarshini arrived at the port of Valletta in which country as part of the Lokayan-26 expedition?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Malta.

In News

  • INS Sudarshini reached the port of Valletta, Malta, on 12th March 2026, during its global expedition Lokayan-26.

Key Points

  • Expedition Name: The ship is on a 22,000-nautical-mile transoceanic voyage titled Lokayan-26, which started from Kochi on 20th January 2026.
  • Diplomatic Vision: The visit aligns with the MAHASAGAR vision, focusing on maritime cooperation and people-to-people ties.
  • Route: Before arriving in Malta, the ship transited the Suez Canal and visited Alexandria, Egypt.
  • Next Destination: From Malta, the ship will sail to France to participate in the Escale à Sète maritime festival.
  • Professional Engagement: The crew will interact with the Armed Forces of Malta to promote mutual trust and interoperability between the two nations.

Additional Information

  • INS Sudarshini
    • An indigenous three-masted sail training ship of the Indian Navy, built by Goa Shipyard Limited. It is designed for training cadets in seamanship and navigation.
  • MAHASAGAR
    • Indian Navy's initiative (Maritime Heads for Active Security And Growth for All in the Region) aimed at collective security and growth in the maritime domain.

questions.text: _____ organized a nationwide Shaheed Diwas Padyatra on 23 March 2026 under the theme “MY Bharat, My Responsibility”?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat).

In News

  • Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat), under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, organized a nationwide Padyatra on 23 March 2026 to mark Shaheed Diwas.

Key Points

  • Purpose: To honor the sacrifices of freedom fighters Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, and Sukhdev and encourage youth-led nation-building.
  • Theme: The 2026 initiative was held under the theme “MY Bharat, My Responsibility”.
  • Scale: The Padyatras covered all 763 districts of India, with the central event held in Faridabad, Haryana.
  • Dignitaries: The Faridabad event was attended by Union MoS for Youth Affairs and Sports, Smt. Raksha Khadse.
  • Digital Push: The campaign included a “Civic Sense Challenge” and a reel competition titled “Ek Yuva Aisa Bhi” on the MY Bharat portal.

What is MY Bharat?

  • Youth Development
    • Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) is an autonomous body set up by the Government of India to serve as a 'one-stop-shop' for youth development, providing equitable access to opportunities and fostering a sense of social responsibility among people aged 15–29.

questions.text: For the year 2025, the Sahitya Akademi Award in the Hindi language has been awarded to Mamta Kalia for which literary work?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Jeete Jee Allahabad.

In News

  • The Sahitya Akademi announced its 2025 annual awards, recognizing literary excellence in 24 Indian languages.

Key Points

  • Hindi Recipient: Renowned author Mamta Kalia won the award for her memoir 'Jeete Jee Allahabad'.
  • Genre: The book falls under the Memoir category, reflecting on her experiences and the literary environment of Allahabad (Prayagraj).
  • Other Language Winners: Navtej Sarna won for English (Crimson Spring - Novel) and Raju Baviskar won for Marathi (Kalyanilya Resha - Autobiography).
  • Award Prize: The honor includes an engraved copper plaque, a shawl, and a cash prize of Rs 1,00,000.
  • Ceremony: The official award presentation is set for March 31, 2026.

Additional Information

  • Sahitya Akademi
    • It is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, dedicated to the promotion of literature in Indian languages.
  • Language Eligibility
    • Apart from the 22 languages in the Constitution, the Akademi also recognizes English and Rajasthani for its annual awards.
